dct_title_s: Kontur Boundaries: Global administrative division with aggregated population
dct_description_sm: Global administrative division with aggregated population. Built from [Kontur Population: Global Population Density for 400m H3 Hexagons](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset) on top of [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) administrative boundaries data. * Per-country subsets of Kontur Boundaries can be found here: [data.humdata.org/organization/kontur](https://data.humdata.org/organization/kontur?res_format=Geopackage&organization=kontur&vocab_Topics=administrative+boundaries-divisions&q=&sort=title_case_insensitive+asc&ext_page_size=100&page=1#datasets-section)
